title: Two `#[Core\Json\Derive]` fields with the same wire key compile.
text: `public int $a;` beside `#[Core\Json\Field(name: "a")] public int $b;` passes `nvs check`. `Core\Json::encode` then writes a document with the key `a` twice, `{"a":1,"a":2}`, and `Core\Json::decodeAs` fills both properties from the one key, so `{"a":5}` decodes to `5` and `5`. `rule:core-classes/derive-field-list` makes the wire key the field's identity, and a duplicate key is a document most readers resolve by keeping the last value. It closes when two fields whose wire keys are equal are a checker error, with a conformance case.
